t: Water and impact-resistant flashlight with anodised aircraft-grade aluminium construction. Features 4 x light modes: flashlight (which provides 11hrs runtime and 82m beam distance), COB worklight (4.5hrs runtime and 33m beam distance), red (8hrs runtime and 7m beam distance), and red strobe function (24hrs runtime and 7m beam distance). Also features dimming and power memory recall, direct-to-red, a powerful magnetic base and steel pocket clip for hands-free lighting options. Ideal for use in roadside emergencies or distress signalling. USB-C rechargeable.
